notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.focusEnabledDescription: Push notifications, app badges, and unread emphasis are paused on every Nessie device.
notifications.focusDisabledDescription: Pause push notifications and mute attention cues on every device while you work.
notifications.deliveryDescription: Every type starts enabled. Nessie skips delivery only when a focused app is already showing that exact conversation or page. When you are elsewhere in Nessie, desktop and browser sessions show a banner and registered devices receive the system notification.
notifications.channelMessagesDescription: New posts in channels you belong to.
notifications.budgetAlertsDescription: Operational budget warnings and blocks for organisation owners.
notifications.scheduledFailuresDescription: A scheduled task that stopped running and needs attention.
notifications.assignedWorkDescription: Project work assigned to you by another person.
notifications.publishedKnowledgeDescription: Knowledge pages newly published where you have access.
notifications.browserUnsupported: This browser does not support web push notifications.
notifications.browserNotConfigured: Browser notifications are not configured on this instance.
notifications.browserBlocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser settings to enable.
notifications.browserEnabled: Enabled for this organization on this browser
notifications.browserDisabledToast: Browser notifications disabled for this organization.
